resources.string: Your location stays on this phone
Pingers checks your location against your Party\'s Spots on this phone. Your server never sees where you are: it only sees encrypted records it can\'t read.
Allow location
Notice friends while the app is closed

Pingers uses your location in the background, even when the app is closed or not in use, to tell when you arrive at or leave one of your Party\'s Spots, and during a Meetup to share where you are with the people in it. Location is only checked on this phone and is never sent to your server.
On the next screen, choose \"Allow all the time\". You can change this later in Settings.
Continue
Open app settings
Know when friends are at a Spot
Pingers tells you when someone from your Party is at the same Spot, and when a Meetup starts. Notifications carry nothing your server can read.
Allow notifications
Not now
Running in the background
Shown while Pingers keeps running for a Meetup, or because Keep Pingers running is on.
Friends nearby
Someone from your Party is at the same Spot, a Meetup started, or a message arrived.
Updates
Changes to your Parties and Meetups that don\'t need a sound.
In a Meetup
Sharing your location with the people in this Meetup.
Pingers is running
Keep Pingers running is on, so friends nearby are noticed on time.
